Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

surviver 0.0.0.9000

  • Initial package, consolidating the Group D analysis from the Lorentz Center workshop (June 2026).
  • Data preparation: ve_population(), sample_cohort(), daily_incidence(), daily_prevalence(), counting_process(), expand_person_days().
  • Exposure: force_of_infection() (age-structured or overall), age_group_sizes(), contact_matrix_hermes().
  • Model: make_stan_data(), fit_ve() with non-centred (default) and centred Stan models, extract_ve(), plot_ve().
  • counting_process(censor_at_vaccination = ) and reported_soon_after_vaccination() to censor people infected before vaccination but reported after it.
  • expected_cases() compares observed and model-expected case counts.
  • Validation helpers: true_ve(), simulate_counts().
  • Datasets: ve_sim_waning, ve_sim_no_waning (HERMES simulations with known VE(t)) and polymod_nl.
  • “Get started” vignette with figures of the epidemic dynamics, model fit and VE estimates (fits precomputed in inst/extdata/ve_fits.rds).
  • Lab notebook article recording development and validation checks.

Developed by Kylie Ainslie.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
